# Fold It, Sort It, Tap It

Version 1.8.0 makes the card easier to live with on a busy dashboard: fold warnings you have read, put the newest warning first, give the card a fixed height, and open a popup or any other action with a tap.

## Less Scrolling

- **Fold a warning you have read to one line.** Each warning has an eye icon in its footer. It folds the warning to its icon, headline and time, and a tap on the line unfolds it again. Before, every warning always took its full height, so on a phone the card could fill the screen. Each device remembers what you folded, also after a reload, and a new or changed warning always shows in full. Thanks to [ralle12345](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/lovelace-nina-and-dwd-warnings-card/943706/10) for the idea in the forum.
- **The card keeps the height you set in the Layout tab.** In a sections view you can give the card a fixed number of rows. The warnings then scroll inside the card while the title stays. Before, the card ignored that height and ran over the cards below it. Without a height, and in masonry views, nothing changes. Thanks to [Mariusthvdb](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/lovelace-nina-and-dwd-warnings-card/943706/9) for the idea in the forum.
- **Newest warning first with `sort_by: newest`.** The card sorts by severity, and warnings of the same level came in no particular order, so a short thunderstorm warning could sit below an older all-day storm warning. `sort_by: newest` puts the warning that started last at the top; warnings with the same start fall back to severity. The default stays `severity`. Thanks to @Marcwa19197 for the idea. _[#108]_

## More to Tap

- **`tap_action` for the whole card.** A tap on the card, outside its own buttons and links, now runs any Home Assistant action: open a [Bubble Card](https://github.com/Clooos/Bubble-Card) popup with `navigate` to `#warning-popup`, open more-info, or perform an action. Before, a tap on the card did nothing. The map, the BUND.DE link, "Show more" and the info icon keep their own function. The editor has a field for it. Thanks to @Marcwa19197 for the idea. _[#108]_
- **Area chips open the NINA device.** With `show_nina_area`, each area chip now links to its NINA device page, also when one warning was merged from several areas. Only admins can open device pages, so for other users the chips stay plain text. The warning itself is still one tap away with the BUND.DE link. Thanks to [Mariusthvdb](https://community.home-assistant.io/t/lovelace-nina-and-dwd-warnings-card/943706/9) for the idea in the forum.
